name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Watermelon OG
description:
Sweet melon meets classic OG. The Cheech & Chong Watermelon OG D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Watermelon OG brings a juicy, refreshing profile: ripe, sweet watermelon up front, grounded by earthy pine and a smooth, gassy OG finish. It's a bright-meets-bold flavor that pairs summery fruit with that familiar OG backbone.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Watermelon OG flavor — sweet, juicy watermelon with earthy, gassy OG notes
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Refreshing flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Watermelon OG is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
